input.change_text: Fixed a command injection vulnerability in the POSIX `which` fallback used by LSP binary detection

output.subject: Command injection in POSIX `which` fallback (LSP binary detection)
output.action_text: Upgrade to `claude-code` 2.1.101+ to patch a command injection vulnerability in the POSIX `which` fallback used by LSP binary detection. Pre-fix, a crafted LSP binary name could execute arbitrary commands during language-server discovery.
